Richard Jefferies, Amaryllis at the Fair.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/richard-jefferies/amaryllis-at-the-fair

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Richard Jefferies, the author, died 1887 (Wikidata death date).
- Edward Garnett, the writer of the introduction, died 1937 (Wikipedia death date).

First publication of the text used: 1887 (SE colophon: 'Amaryllis at the Fair was published in 1887 by Richard Jefferies').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (the facts do not establish the country of first publication, and the text was first published 1887; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these people. The last person to die, Edward Garnett, died in 1937, so that term ended on 31 December 2007 at the latest.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

- Wikidata Q434687 (Richard Jefferies), P570 = 1887-08-14
